mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5%, it indicates monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer and business spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If SPX returns are positive in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE < 4%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth coupled with low unemployment indicates a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of cases when GDPC1 growth > 2% and UNRATE < 4%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, low unemployment and high federal funds rate signal impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If SPX returns are positive in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and UNRATE < 4%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts indicate strong demand in the housing market, which spills over into the broader economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of cases when HOUST is increasing, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of cases when INDPRO is increasing, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing real sales indicate strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of cases when RSAFS growth > 4%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing employment coupled with stable inflation indicates a Goldilocks economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of cases when PAYEMS growth > 1% and CPIAUCSL growth < 2%, the hypothesis is rejected.
